summary: Iteration 17: Comprehensive regression for BidBlitz V2 – auctions list, new admin image editor (PATCH + upload), auth, wallet, feature flags, Leaflet map pages. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests PASS. Frontend: navigation works, homepage loads in German without JS exceptions (only expected 401s from /auth/me when unauthenticated). Two findings reported: (1) duplicate 'AirPods Pro 3' auction with generic Unsplash stock photo instead of official Apple CDN, (2) login form inputs use type='text' instead of type='email' which breaks standard selectors.

minor.issue: Two 'AirPods Pro 3' auctions exist. One uses official Apple CDN (store.storeimages.cdn-apple.com) – correct. The other still uses a generic Unsplash stock photo (images.unsplash.com/photo-1677346414290-d337cbc682a6). User explicitly requested no stock photos for AirPods. Needs image URL replaced or duplicate removed.

ui_bugs.issue: Email input uses type='text' (not type='email'). Browser-level email validation + autofill heuristics don't apply. Testids login-email-input / login-password-input exist but many standard selectors (input[type=email]) fail.

issues: 'GOOD AFTERNOON' greeting is rendered in English while rest of UI is German – inconsistent i18n
